howto.name: Upload the PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Strip annotations
howto.text: Click Delete. PrivaTools removes every annotation except form fields: highlights, comments, sticky notes, drawings, stamps and links.

howto.name: Download the cleaned PDF
howto.text: The visible page content is unchanged; comments, markup and links are gone, while form fields stay fillable.

faq.q: Will this remove form fields too?
faq.a: No. Form fields are technically annotations too, but they are kept, so a fillable form stays fillable.
Yes — hyperlinks are link annotations, so they are removed along with the comments and markup. Form fields remain, so the result is not completely static.
No. Signature fields are form fields and are kept, but the file is rewritten, which breaks any digital signature in it.
